d: Prashant Kishor On Samrat Choudhary : bihar ke mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri se mulakat ko lekar jan suraj ke sansthapak prashant kishor ne saphaee di hai. unhonne kaha ki vah ek shraddh karyakram men shamil hone gae the, jahan mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri bhi pahunche the. aise men unse milna samajik aur rajnitik shishtachar ka hissa tha.prashant kishor ne kaha, "kal kis samrat se mile hain, 7vin phel samrat se ya CM samrat se?" unhonne kaha ki vah bihar ke mukhyamantri se samajik aur rajnitik shishtachar ke tahat mile the. kisi se milne ka matlab yah nahin hai ki unke bare men pahle kahi…
